messages:
Kelsea: Quick sync — need to lock SI co-sell lead triage rules for the AtlasCloud joint announce next Wed. Draft intake here: https://bit.ly/si-intake-form :spiral_calendar_pad: We have overlapping accounts between cloud marketplace and the SI. Thoughts on priority?

Daniel S: +1. My short take: if the customer came in via marketplace purchase or trial signup, marketplace gets first-touch routing. SI gets enablement/partner credit but not primary pipeline unless SI can show prior engagement.

Mike (Infra): Question — what about existing enterprise customers where the SI has been working on infra proofs? Do we override AE ownership? :thinking_face:

Lee (Sales): My preference: keep AE ownership for any account with an active enterprise contract. For net-new accounts: rule set I propose — 1) origin=marketplace -> marketplace route, 2) origin=si AND SI engagement in last 90d -> SI route, 3) both active -> AE arbitration + split credit.

Jess (SE): We need required metadata on the intake to make this deterministic: origin tag, source_id, first_touch_timestamp, SI_case_link, marketplace_order_id. Also add a boolean "si_claimed_proof" (e.g., screenshot or meeting notes).

intake-bot: New lead tag schema received. Example claim payload accepted by the intake service:
```
{
  "origin":"marketplace|si|direct",
  "source_id":"<uuid>",
  "first_touch_ts":"<unix_ts>",
  "evidence_link":"https://...",
  "acv_bucket":"<lt_50k|50-250k|gt_250k>"
}
```
Routing algorithm (pseudo):
```
if origin=="marketplace": route=MARKETPLACE
else if origin=="si" and si_last_engagement_days <= 90: route=SI
else if acv_bucket=="gt_250k": route=AE_ESCALATE
else route=AE
```

Eva (PM): Can we add an exception for partner-led technical pilots where SI has driven >2 technical sessions? Those pilots tend to convert and we should respect partner motion. Also we should auto-notify #partners/atlascloud when route=SI.

Kelsea: Agree on the pilot exception, let's formalize criteria: >2 technical sessions OR signed MOU. For notifications — intake-bot can post an agenda in #partners/atlascloud and ping the named partner rep.

Daniel S: For crediting, propose split: if both marketplace+SI contributed -> 70/30 to marketplace for first-touch marketplace closed-won; if SI-led conversion and evidence present -> 60/40 to SI. Need legal to ok MM/partner credit language.

Lee (Sales): We also need a small UI change in the CRM: show "claimed_by" (marketplace|si|ae) and evidence URL on lead card so SDRs see history at glance.

Jess (SE): I'll update the intake form and include the evidence upload field. ETA EOD Friday.

intake-bot: Action created: intake:update-form -> PR #842 created by @Jess. Will trigger schema migration if approved.

Kelsea: Action items recap: 1) Jess -> update intake form + evidence field (due EOD Fri) 2) Daniel -> own pilot and credit split proposal (due next Tue) 3) Lee -> CRM card change request (submit ticket to ops) 4) Mike -> confirm no infra override for active enterprise contracts (quick check) 5) Eva -> draft exception criteria doc for partner-led pilots. I'll schedule a 30m kickoff tomorrow 10:30 PT.

Lee (Sales): :+1: noted. I'll file the ops ticket now.

Mike (Infra): I'll validate contract logic with legal & infra by EOD Monday.

Daniel S: I'll draft the credit appendix and loop in legal.

Eva (PM): I'll put the exception doc in Confluence and link it to the intake form.

Kelsea: Thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround. Please react to the message once your task is in flight so I can close the loop. :eyes: :heart:

Jess (SE): Reacted :thumbsup:

intake-bot: Scheduled: pilot-kickoff @ 2024-06-05T10:30:00-07:00 (calendar invite sent).
